test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The audience was asked to dress ________, since it was a formal occasion at the Royal Palace.
solution: The correct answer is **"appropriately".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The sentence describes a situation where the audience is asked to dress in a particular manner for a formal occasion at the Royal Palace. • "Appropriately" would mean suitably or properly about. (उपयुक्त रीति से) • **Example**:* She didn't think we were **appropriately**__ dressed for a wedding.* • In this context, it suggests dressing formally or with due respect for the formal occasion at the Royal Palace. • Given these, the most fitting option is **"appropriately," **implying the audience should dress accordingly for the formal setting. • Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2."** **Correct sentence**: *"The audience was asked to dress __**appropriately**__, since it was a formal occasion at the Royal Palace."* ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__** • Looking at other options: • "Informally": in a relaxed, friendly, or unofficial manner. (अनौपचारिक रूप से) • "Gaudily": n a way that is unpleasantly bright in colour or decoration. (ऐसा कोई तरीका नहीं जो रंग या सजावट में अप्रिय रूप से चमकीला हो) • "Casually": in a relaxed and informal way. (अनौपचारिक रूप से; लापरवाही से; अकस्‍मात) 198:T90a, The correct answer is:** 'Luggage'**.
